class TacticalStrategy(BaselineStrategy):
    name = "tactical"

    def __init__(self, data: WorldData | None = None, llm=None, **flags) -> None:
        super().__init__(data, llm)
        unknown = set(flags) - set(FLAGS)
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown tactical flags: {sorted(unknown)}")
        self.flags = {name: bool(flags.get(name, False)) for name in FLAGS}
        self.tplans: dict[str, Plan] = {}
        self.banned_case_kinds: set[str] = set()  # contradicted: never again in this case

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ prepare
    def prepare(self, neg: Negotiation) -> None:
        if neg.data is not None:
            self.data = neg.data  # the session's view for this case: its own facts (WorldData.with_case)
        buyer = neg.buyer
        goal = buyer.get("category_goal", "routine")
        parts = neg.case.get("parts") or []
        current = buyer.get("current_unit_price")
        for sid, thread in neg.threads.items():
            _, terms = thread.standing
            profile = build_profile(self.data, sid, neg.case)
            policy = self._policy(goal, profile)
            full_cost = self._full_cost(parts, sid)
            cost_source = "own plant" if full_cost else ""
            if full_cost and goal in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
                full_cost = round(full_cost * SHOULD_COST_SHARE, 2)  # one cost for the charge and the floor
            guess = None
            if not full_cost and goal in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
                guessed, cost_source = self._fallback_full_cost(neg, sid)
                guess = self._supplier_estimate(neg, sid, guessed, profile) if guessed else None
            self._estimate_supplier(neg, sid, full_cost, profile)
            floor = self._floor(neg, full_cost, policy)
            open_c = neg.cost(sid, terms)
            gt = estimate(self.data, neg.case, sid, terms.get("unit_price"), tuple(profile.traits))
            if gt.lower and goal not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
                floor = gt.lower  # one floor: the ground truth's (it knows below-cost sellers and countries)
            target_c = self._target_c(neg, sid, terms, policy, profile, floor, current, gt)
            plan = Plan(sid, self._name(sid), policy, profile, open_c, target_c, floor, full_cost, gt)
            plan.guess = guess
            plan.lower_c, plan.upper_c = self._bounds_c(neg, sid, terms, gt, target_c, open_c)
            if terms.get("unit_price") is not None:
                rate = buyer.get("interest_rate", 0.08) * (2 if profile.has("cash_short") else 1)
                plan.belief = FloorBelief(neg.case, terms, thread.standard_terms, gt.lower, rate)
                plan.belief.ppm = profile.ppm  # scorecard ppm: what a chargeback really costs it
            plan.evidence = self._evidence(neg, sid, terms.get("unit_price"), current) if terms else []
            if self.flags["news"] and terms:
                plan.evidence += self._news_evidence(neg, sid, profile)
            body = thread.latest.get("body") or ""
            clauses = [o for o in neg.case.get("term_options", {}).get("index_clause") or [] if o]
            if "index_clause" in neg.case["negotiable"] and any(o.get("series") in body for o in clauses):
                # it argues its price with the very index a clause would follow: the clause answers it. P02's
                # supplier dropped its price by 15-22 for one and never went under 372.96 without (P-13, P-15, P-19)
                plan.requests.add("index_clause")
            if profile.has("hedged"):
                plan.banned_kinds.add("index")  # "not our reality" until its hedge runs out
            if gt.market_supports_ask:
                plan.banned_kinds.add("index")  # the indices back its ask: citing them helps it, not us
            self.tplans[sid] = plan
            neg.recorder.event(
                "plan",
                session_id=neg.session_id,
                case_id=neg.case_id,
                supplier_id=sid,
                strategy=self.name,
                goal=goal,
                policy=policy.__dict__,
                profile=profile.summary(),
                trait_refs=profile.traits,
                open_price=terms.get("unit_price"),
                open_c=open_c,
                target_c=target_c,
                lower_c=plan.lower_c,
                upper_c=plan.upper_c,
                ground_truth=gt.summary(),
                c_alt=neg.c_alt,
                floor_price=floor,
                full_cost=full_cost,
                full_cost_source=cost_source,
                guessed_full_cost=(guess or {}).get("full_cost"),
                evidence=[{"kind": e.kind, "refs": e.refs, "sentence": e.sentence} for e in plan.evidence],
            )
            log.info(
                "%s plan [%s %s]: price open %s lower %s upper %s (asked %s%%, justified %s%%) | C target %s upper %s",
                sid,
                goal,
                ",".join(sorted(profile.traits)) or "-",
                terms.get("unit_price"),
                gt.lower,
                gt.upper,
                gt.asked_pct,
                gt.justified_pct,
                _k(target_c),
                _k(plan.upper_c),
            )

    def _policy(self, goal: str, p: SupplierProfile) -> Policy:
        base = POLICIES.get(goal, DEFAULT_POLICY)
        anchor, beta, recip = base.anchor, base.beta, base.reciprocity
        trade = list(base.trade_first)
        if p.has("underutilised"):
            anchor, beta = anchor + 0.03, beta + 0.5
        markup = base.markup
        if p.has("full_order_book") or p.has("below_cost"):
            anchor = max(0.02, anchor - 0.03)
            markup = max(markup, 0.0)  # no room under its cost: it is already there or does not need us
        if p.has("price_frozen"):
            anchor = max(0.02, anchor - 0.02)
        if p.has("approval_ladder"):
            beta += 0.5  # it moves in small approved steps: no reason for us to move fast
        if p.has("cash_short"):
            trade.insert(0, "payment_days")
        if p.has("wants_volume") or p.has("full_order_book") or p.has("price_frozen"):
            trade += ["contract_months", "volume_per_year"]
        if p.has("we_pay_late") or p.has("relationship"):
            recip = min(1.0, recip + 0.1)
        return Policy(anchor, beta, recip, markup, base.claims_first, tuple(dict.fromkeys(trade)))

    def _evidence(self, neg, sid, open_price, current):
        out = super()._evidence(neg, sid, open_price, current)
        if self.data:
            parts = neg.case.get("parts") or []
            out += self.data.evidence_orders(parts, sid, open_price)
            if self.flags["fresh_args"]:
                out += self.data.evidence_orders_per_part(parts, sid)
            out += data_facts(self.data, parts, all_windows=self.flags["all_windows"])
            if self.flags["fresh_claims"]:
                later = self.data.evidence_complaints(parts, sid, since="2025-10-01")
                if open_price and not any(e.kind == "should_cost" for e in out):
                    later += self.data.evidence_should_cost(parts, open_price, margin=1.0)
                for e in later:  # material for rounds 2+: round 1 already carries our best three
                    e.meta = {**(e.meta or {}), "later": True}
                out += later
        return sorted(out, key=lambda e: -e.strength)

    def _full_cost(self, parts: list[str], supplier_id: str) -> float | None:
        """The should-cost of THIS supplier's plant for a single-part case; None otherwise.

        Another supplier's estimate is a different plant (cost base, process) and a bundle's price is
        not one part's cost: guessing would push the floor and the margin charge the wrong way."""
        if not self.data or len(parts) != 1:
            return None
        rows = self.data.query(
            "SELECT unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ? AND supplier_id = ? ORDER BY estimate_date DESC",
            (parts[0], supplier_id),
        )
        return rows[0]["unit_cost"] if rows and rows[0]["unit_cost"] else None

    def _fallback_full_cost(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> tuple[float | None, str]:
        """A strategic supplier's full cost where its own plant has no should-cost: the price of the main sheet of
        its first message less the sustainable margin, x SHOULD_COST_SHARE (its alternatives are other structures,
        and a cheaper one would set the guess too low). None where the case puts no price on the supplier's margin
        (no charge to protect) or nothing is quoted."""
        buyer = neg.buyer
        margin = buyer.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
        if not margin or not buyer.get("relationship_eur_per_point"):
            return None, ""
        first = next((m for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages if m.get("term_sheets")), None)
        opening = ((first or {}).get("term_sheets") or [{}])[0].get("terms", {}).get("unit_price")
        if not isinstance(opening, int | float) or opening <= 0:
            return None, ""
        return round(opening * (1 - margin / 100) * SHOULD_COST_SHARE, 2), "opening less the sustainable margin"

    def _guess_floor(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, terms: dict) -> float:
        """Under a guessed cost, the price that minimises C on these terms with the guessed charge (0 without a
        guess): no ask and no accept goes under it."""
        if not plan.guess or terms.get("unit_price") is None:
            return 0.0
        std = neg.threads[sid].standard_terms

        def c(price: float) -> float:
            return total_cost(neg.case, {**terms, "unit_price": price}, std, plan.guess)

        lo, hi = 0.0, terms["unit_price"] * 1.5
        for _ in range(60):
            a, b = lo + (hi - lo) / 3, hi - (hi - lo) / 3
            if c(a) < c(b):
                hi = b
            else:
                lo = a
        return math.ceil((lo + hi) / 2 * 100 - 1e-6) / 100

    def _standard_terms(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> dict:
        """The supplier's standard terms for the relationship term: its quote PDF, then its master data, then its
        opening sheet. The PDFs of P01, P02, P03 and P10 name neither payment nor Incoterm, which left the charge
        out of C altogether (P02 closed at 345.39 with EUR 179k of it, score 0). What stays unknown is taken as
        the value that charges most - too high a charge costs a little price, too low a charge scores 0."""
        std = dict(neg.threads[sid].standard_terms)
        master = (self.data.supplier(sid) if self.data else None) or {}
        first = next((m for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages if m.get("term_sheets")), None)
        opening = first["term_sheets"][0]["terms"] if first else {}
        fixed = neg.case.get("fixed_terms", {})
        for name in ("payment_days", "incoterm"):
            for source in (master, opening):
                if std.get(name) is None and fixed.get(name) is None and source.get(name) is not None:
                    std[name] = source[name]
        freight = neg.buyer["freight_eur_per_unit"]
        if std.get("incoterm") not in freight and fixed.get("incoterm") is None:
            std["incoterm"] = max(freight, key=freight.get)
        if std.get("payment_days") is None and fixed.get("payment_days") is None:
            options = neg.case.get("term_options", {}).get("payment_days") or []
            std["payment_days"] = min(options, default=neg.buyer["reference_payment_days"])
        return std

    def _estimate_supplier(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, full_cost: float | None, p: SupplierProfile) -> None:
        """Our estimate of the supplier for the relationship term in C (stabilise, secure_supply)."""
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not full_cost:
            neg.supplier_estimates.pop(sid, None)
            return
        neg.supplier_estimates[sid] = self._supplier_estimate(neg, sid, full_cost, p)

    def _supplier_estimate(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, full_cost: float, p: SupplierProfile) -> dict:
        rate = neg.buyer.get("interest_rate", 0.08)
        return {
            "full_cost": full_cost,
            "interest_rate": rate * CASH_SHORT_RATE if p.has("cash_short") else rate,  # money now is dearer to it
            "usual_rate": rate,
            "standard": self._standard_terms(neg, sid),
        }

    def _update_upper(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> None:
        """The upper bound follows the evidence: where this supplier will stop with us (its offers, last words,
        the shrinking path of its steps), priced on the best structure. Offline on 28 practice sessions this
        estimate met the real stopping point within 8 % before the first reply and 1-3 % by round 3-4.
        The anchor stays where the data put it; only how far we go and when we take it follow the supplier."""
        _, theirs = neg.threads[sid].standing
        insisted = {r for r, n in plan.request_counts.items() if n >= 2}
        stop_c, stop_terms = plan.belief.best_package(
            lambda t: neg.cost(sid, t),
            lambda t: neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, t),
            allow=lambda t: all(satisfies(neg.case, t, theirs or {}, r, plan.proposed) for r in insisted),
        )
        if not math.isfinite(stop_c):
            return
        _, terms = neg.threads[sid].standing
        cap = min(neg.c_alt, neg.cost(sid, terms) if terms else math.inf, plan.open_c)
        before = plan.upper_c
        plan.stop_c = stop_c
        plan.upper_c = min(max(stop_c * (1 + STOP_MARGIN), plan.target_c * (1 + UPPER_ROOM)), cap)
        if neg.supplier_estimates.get(sid):
            # where only the price moves, 1 % and 6 % of C are more than the whole room (P01: 5 %, P02: 2 %):
            # the bound became the supplier's current offer and every offer counted as good enough - P01 took an
            # alternative in round 3 at 134.80 while the supplier was still coming down (0.733, P-20)
            room = max(0.0, plan.open_c - plan.target_c)
            plan.upper_c = min(max(stop_c + STOP_ROOM * room, plan.target_c + UPPER_ROOM_SHARE * room), cap)
        neg.recorder.event(
            "belief",
            session_id=neg.session_id,
            supplier_id=sid,
            belief=plan.belief.summary(),
            stop_c=round(stop_c, 2),
            stop_price=(stop_terms or {}).get("unit_price"),
            upper_before=round(before, 2) if math.isfinite(before) else None,
            upper_after=round(plan.upper_c, 2) if math.isfinite(plan.upper_c) else None,
        )
        log.info(
            "%s belief: stop ~%s (price %s), upper %s -> %s",
            sid,
            _k(stop_c),
            (stop_terms or {}).get("unit_price"),
            _k(before),
            _k(plan.upper_c),
        )

    def _floor(self, neg: Negotiation, full_cost: float | None, policy: Policy) -> float | None:
        if not full_cost:
            return None
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            margin = neg.buyer.get("sustainable_margin_pct") or 0
            return round(full_cost / (1 - margin / 100), 2)
        return round(full_cost * (1 + policy.markup), 2)

    def _target_c(self, neg, sid, terms, policy, profile, floor, current, gt: GroundTruth | None = None) -> float:
        """The C of our first ask: the deepest credible price on our C-optimal terms - just under the
        supplier's estimated floor when we have one, else an anchor below the reference price."""
        open_price = terms.get("unit_price")
        if open_price is None:
            return math.inf
        price_only = bool(gt and gt.lower and gt.lower >= open_price * 0.95)  # the prior says: only the price moves
        depth = ANCHOR_PRICE_ONLY if price_only else ANCHOR_WITH_LEVERS
        extra = ANCHOR_DATA_EXTRA
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") == "routine":
            # P07 (bundling, routine): a 13 % ask got 5.59 and four rounds (0.721, P-13); 25-26 % got "your
            # target prices are not feasible", 5.69 and a final offer in round 2 (0.585 P-15, 0.663 P-22)
            depth, extra = min(depth, ANCHOR_ROUTINE), 0.0
        if neg.supplier_estimates.get(sid):
            # the margin charge is in C: the ask may go as deep as a price-only talk, it stops at the price that
            # costs us least (below). P01 came down to 132.20 after a 10 % ask, to 137.00 after a 3 % one
            depth, extra = ANCHOR_PRICE_ONLY, 0.0
        elif neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            depth, extra = min(depth, ANCHOR_RELATIONSHIP), 0.0  # squeezing a strategic supplier costs us C
        # round 1 carries 67 % of all supplier movement and no supplier ever walked over a deep first offer
        # (0 of 917 replies); within a case deeper first offers went with better scores - so we open deep
        candidates = [open_price * (1 - depth)]
        if gt and gt.lower and gt.grounded:
            candidates.append(gt.lower * (1 - UNDER_FLOOR))
        alt_price = ((neg.buyer.get("alternative") or {}).get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price")
        if alt_price and alt_price < open_price:
            candidates.append(alt_price * 0.98)
        # the data may take it deeper - a cheaper alternative, a low grounded floor - but not past 5 points more
        price = max(min(candidates), open_price * (1 - depth - extra))
        # no hard floor for strategic suppliers: the relationship term already prices a squeeze in C, and
        # our cost estimate can sit above its real one (P02: should-cost 380 over a 371 quote, C_best ~364)
        price = min(price, open_price)
        ideal = complete_offer(neg.case, self._optimise(neg, sid, {**terms, "unit_price": round(price, 2)}))
        if neg.supplier_estimates.get(sid):
            # with the margin charge in C, a price under the one that costs us least costs more charge than it
            # saves - and the supplier may agree to it (P02 agreed to 345.39): the first ask stops there
            for _ in range(2):
                ideal["unit_price"] = max(ideal["unit_price"], round(self._cheapest_price(neg, sid, ideal), 2))
                ideal = complete_offer(neg.case, self._optimise(neg, sid, ideal))
        return min(neg.cost(sid, ideal), neg.cost(sid, terms))

    def _bounds_c(self, neg, sid, terms, gt: GroundTruth, target_c: float, open_c: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
        """The bounds in C, on our C-optimal terms: a fair price on poor terms (a short contract that
        leaves need uncovered, early payment, dear freight) must not pass as a good deal."""
        lower_c, upper_c = -math.inf, min(open_c, neg.c_alt)
        if gt.lower:
            low = self._ideal(neg, sid, terms, gt.lower)
            if neg.supplier_estimates.get(sid):
                # under a margin charge a price below the one that costs us least costs more, not less: the bound
                # sits at that price (a floor factor of 0.86 under a strategic supplier's cost put it above its quote)
                low["unit_price"] = max(low["unit_price"], round(self._cheapest_price(neg, sid, low), 2))
            lower_c = neg.cost(sid, low)
        if gt.upper:
            upper_c = min(upper_c, neg.cost(sid, self._ideal(neg, sid, terms, gt.upper)))
        # room to concede above our first ask, whatever the calibration says (P05: an 18 % anchor over a 22 %
        # floor left upper == anchor and only 0.4 % steps) - never above its quote or our alternative
        return lower_c, min(max(upper_c, target_c * (1 + UPPER_ROOM)), open_c, neg.c_alt)

    def _ideal(self, neg, sid, terms: dict, price: float) -> dict:
        return complete_offer(neg.case, self._optimise(neg, sid, {**terms, "unit_price": round(price, 2)}))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ per thread
    def decide(self, neg: Negotiation, supplier_id: str) -> Decision:
        t, plan = neg.threads[supplier_id], self.tplans[supplier_id]
        if not t.live:
            return Decision.drop(supplier_id, f"thread {t.status}")
        self._learn(neg, supplier_id, plan)
        sheet_id, theirs = neg.best_offer(supplier_id)  # judge it by its best sheet for us, not its first
        if theirs.get("unit_price") is None or not math.isfinite(plan.target_c):
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "no price to negotiate on")
        if text := self._text_price_offer(neg, supplier_id, plan):
            return text  # it wrote a lower price than it sheeted: ask for that first, even next to an agreement
        if t.status == "agreed":
            if take := self._take_agreed(neg, supplier_id):
                return take
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "agreed")
        limit = neg.case.get("round_limit") or 10
        if limit - t.arena_rounds <= 0 or (limit - t.rounds_used == 1 and t.our_price_path()):
            # the last round is kept for the close - unless we have not asked anything yet: with round_limit 1
            # holding would never send an offer at all
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "last round: keep it for the close")
        if neg.seconds_to_deadline() < 120:
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "the deadline is near")
        if counter := self._floor_counter(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs):
            return counter

        their_c = neg.cost(supplier_id, theirs)
        signals = reply_signals(t.latest.get("body", ""))
        # the lower bound is where we anchor, not where we stop: below it we keep asking - the supplier
        # ends it with a stall or a final offer, and only it knows its real floor
        closing_word = t.status == "final_offer" or (signals["firm"] and t.rounds_used > 0)
        rest_pending = self._rest_pending(neg, supplier_id, plan)
        if (
            not closing_word
            and not rest_pending
            and (their_c <= plan.lower_c or self._undercut_after_big_step(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs))
        ):
            if reanchor := self._reanchor(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs, their_c):
                return reanchor
        if alt := self._take_alternative(neg, supplier_id, plan):
            return alt  # its cheapest sheet is an alternative: the arena closes on the primary one, so ask for it
        last_word = t.status == "final_offer" or (signals["firm"] and t.rounds_used > 0)
        if last_word:
            # a last word is taken (the guards still check it): across ~65 pushes on final offers, 17 % ended in a
            # walk-away for ~+0.05 on average - only an RFQ with a safe rival offer may push once, with a real step
            if (
                their_c > plan.upper_c
                and not plan.probed_final
                and self._may_probe(neg, supplier_id, their_c)
                and self._may_push(neg, supplier_id)
            ):
                plan.probed_final = True
                last = plan.our_c[-1] if plan.our_c else plan.target_c
                ask_c = last + 0.5 * max(0.0, their_c - last)  # not capped: a crumb reads as a refusal (P18)
                return self._offer(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c, probe=True)
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "last word: take it", their_c=their_c)
        if not rest_pending and (match := self._price_match(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs, their_c)):
            return match

        if plan.stalls >= 2 and their_c <= plan.upper_c:
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "stalled inside our upper bound: take it", their_c=their_c)
        if plan.stalls >= 3:
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "the supplier stopped moving", their_c=their_c)
        ask_c = self._next_c(neg, supplier_id, plan, their_c)
        if ask_c >= their_c * (1 - DONE_EPS) and not self._supplier_done(neg, supplier_id, plan):
            # our estimate of its floor said "this is it" but sat 3-12 % too high (P18: 249k against a C_best of
            # 223k): ask once more just under its offer - it ends the thread itself with a final offer, a stall or an
            # agreement (practice 10 Oct: P01 0.831 -> 0.946, P18 0.618 -> 0.685, P10 0.663 -> 0.601, rest unchanged)
            last = plan.our_c[-1] if plan.our_c else plan.target_c
            ask_c = max(their_c * (1 - PATIENT_GAP), last * (1 + MIN_STEP))
        if ask_c >= their_c * (1 - DONE_EPS):
            return Decision.hold(supplier_id, "their offer meets our ask", ask_c=ask_c, their_c=their_c)
        return self._offer(neg, supplier_id, plan, theirs, ask_c, their_c)

    def _learn(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> None:
        """Read what came back since we last looked: argument checks, stalls, a cost breakdown."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        replies = t.supplier_messages
        for reply in replies[plan.seen_replies :]:
            if self.flags["fresh_args"]:
                self._learn_claims(t, plan, reply)
            for res in [] if self.flags["fresh_args"] else reply.get("claim_results") or []:
                i, result = res.get("index"), res.get("result")
                if not isinstance(i, int) or not 0 <= i < len(plan.last_claims):
                    continue
                kind = plan.last_claims[i].kind
                if result == "contradicted":
                    self.banned_case_kinds.add(kind)
                elif result == "irrelevant":
                    plan.banned_kinds.add(kind)
            if not plan.breakdown_read:
                self._read_breakdown(neg, sid, plan, reply)
            if FIGURES_ASKED.search(reply.get("body", "")):
                plan.figures_asked = True
            if (
                self.flags["answers"]
                and MUST_CLAUSE.search(reply.get("body", ""))
                and "index_clause" in neg.case["negotiable"]
            ):
                plan.request_counts["index_clause"] = max(2, plan.request_counts.get("index_clause", 0))
            asked = {r for r in requests_in(reply.get("body", "")) if r in neg.case["negotiable"]}
            for r in asked:
                plan.request_counts[r] = plan.request_counts.get(r, 0) + 1
            plan.requests |= asked
            for series in CITED_DRIVER.findall(reply.get("body", "")):
                if series[0] not in plan.pressures:
                    plan.pressures.append(series[0])
            for fact in reply_facts(self.data, reply.get("body", ""), all_windows=self.flags["all_windows"]):
                if fact.sentence not in plan.used_sentences and all(fact.sentence != c.sentence for c in plan.counters):
                    plan.counters.append(fact)
            for f, values in proposed_values(neg.case, reply.get("term_sheets") or []).items():
                plan.proposed.setdefault(f, [])
                plan.proposed[f] += [v for v in values if v not in plan.proposed[f]]
                if len(plan.proposed[f]) > 1:
                    plan.requests.add(f)  # it varies this field across its sheets: a lever it trades on
            sheet_prices = [s["terms"].get("unit_price") for s in reply.get("term_sheets") or []]
            sheet_prices = [p for p in sheet_prices if p]
            said = [
                p
                for p in prices_in_text(reply.get("body", ""))
                if sheet_prices and 0.6 * min(sheet_prices) < p < min(sheet_prices) - 0.004
            ]
            if said:
                plan.text_price = min(said)  # "I am dropping the price to EUR 28.00" on a 29.09 sheet (P05)
            sheets = reply.get("term_sheets") or []
            if sheets and sheets[0]["terms"].get("index_clause"):
                plan.requests.add("index_clause")  # it proposed one: it wants one
        if len(replies) > plan.seen_replies and plan.seen_replies > 0:
            path = [neg.cost(sid, (m.get("term_sheets") or [{}])[0].get("terms") or {}) for m in replies]
            path = [c for c in path if math.isfinite(c)]
            if len(path) >= 2:
                moved = path[-2] - path[-1]
                plan.stalls = plan.stalls + 1 if moved <= path[-2] * STALL_EPS else 0
        if plan.belief and len(replies) > plan.seen_replies:
            for reply in replies[max(plan.seen_replies, 1) :]:
                plan.belief.observe(reply)
            self._update_upper(neg, sid, plan)
        plan.seen_replies = len(replies)

    def _learn_claims(self, t, plan: Plan, reply: dict) -> None:
        """The arena's checks of our last e-mail, matched to its arguments the way the arena reads them (the
        `index` counts the arena's arguments, not our sentences: P11's two scorecard lines were one)."""
        before = t.messages[: next((i for i, m in enumerate(t.messages) if m is reply), len(t.messages))]
        ours = next((m for m in reversed(before) if m.get("from") == "buyer" and not m.get("action")), None)
        if not ours:
            return
        read = arguments_read(ours.get("body", ""), ours.get("refs"), self._facts())
        for res in reply.get("claim_results") or []:
            i, result = res.get("index"), res.get("result")
            if not isinstance(i, int) or not 0 <= i < len(read):
                continue
            key, refs = read[i]
            if result == "duplicate" and key[0] not in ("index", "rival", "orders"):
                plan.spent_kinds.add(key[0])  # counted once per kind, whatever the ID (orders: per part, by key)
            kinds = {c.kind for c in plan.last_claims if set(c.refs) & refs}
            if result == "contradicted":
                self.banned_case_kinds |= kinds
            elif result == "irrelevant":
                plan.banned_kinds |= kinds

    def _facts(self) -> dict:
        return self.data.facts if self.data else {}

    def _spent_keys(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> set:
        """Every argument the arena has read from our e-mails to this supplier: citing it again is a duplicate."""
        out = set()
        for m in neg.threads[sid].messages:
            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
                out |= {k for k, _ in arguments_read(m.get("body", ""), m.get("refs"), self._facts())}
        return out

    def _arg_key(self, e: Evidence) -> tuple | None:
        return argument_key(e.refs[0], self._facts()) if e.refs else None

    def _read_breakdown(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, reply: dict) -> None:
        """A cost breakdown XLSX: the supplier's own cost per unit is the floor it will not go below."""
        for att in reply.get("attachments") or []:
            name = (att.get("name") or "").lower()
            if not name.endswith(".xlsx") or "breakdown" not in name or not att.get("text"):
                continue
            full = parse_breakdown(att["text"])
            price = neg.threads[sid].standing[1].get("unit_price")
            if not full or not price or not 0.3 * price < full < price * 1.05:
                continue
            plan.breakdown_read = True
            plan.full_cost, plan.guess = full, None
            if plan.gt and neg.buyer.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
                floor = round(full * (1 + plan.policy.markup), 2)
                if plan.gt.lower is None or floor < plan.gt.lower:  # it told us it has more room: use it
                    plan.gt.lower, plan.gt.grounded = floor, True
                    _, theirs = neg.threads[sid].standing
                    plan.lower_c = neg.cost(sid, self._ideal(neg, sid, theirs, floor))
                    plan.target_c = min(plan.target_c, plan.lower_c)
            # where its margin costs us C, the relationship term now prices it exactly; elsewhere the
            # breakdown is its own account of cost - information, not a floor that forces our hand
            self._estimate_supplier(neg, sid, full, plan.profile)
            neg.recorder.event(
                "breakdown_read", session_id=neg.session_id, supplier_id=sid, full_cost=full, floor=plan.floor_price
            )
            log.info("%s: cost breakdown says full cost %.2f, floor %s", sid, full, plan.floor_price)

    def _next_c(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, their_c: float) -> float:
        """Boulware over the rounds we can still play, capped by what the supplier gave last."""
        if not plan.our_c:
            return plan.target_c
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        last = plan.our_c[-1]
        budget = self._round_budget(neg, sid)
        progress = min(1.0, t.rounds_used / max(1, budget - 1))
        curve = plan.target_c + (their_c - plan.target_c) * progress**plan.policy.beta
        by_time = max(0.0, curve - last)
        theirs_path = self._their_c_path(neg, sid)
        their_move = theirs_path[-2] - theirs_path[-1] if len(theirs_path) >= 2 else 0.0
        min_step = MIN_STEP * last
        gap = max(0.0, their_c - last)
        if self._rest_pending(neg, sid, plan):
            return min(last + min_step, their_c, plan.upper_c)
        if APPROVAL_PENDING.search(t.latest.get("body", "")):
            # "we need to clarify this internally" / "more than my band allows": its boss approves the next
            # step anyway (8 of 8 in the back office) - hold, with the smallest visible move
            return min(last + min_step, their_c, plan.upper_c)
        if plan.stalls == 1:
            # no move from it: a visible step - a new structure carries it too (holding cost D02 0.608 -> 0.587)
            step = max(min_step, 0.15 * gap)
            plan.lever_turn = True
        elif plan.stalls >= 2:
            step = max(by_time * 0.5, 0.25 * gap)  # break the deadlock
        else:
            # a real counter-step: at least half of its last move (cent steps read as no movement)
            step = min(plan.policy.reciprocity * max(their_move, 0.0), max(by_time, 0.5 * max(their_move, 0.0)))
            step = max(step, min_step)
            if self.flags["persistent"]:
                step = min(step, max(PERSIST_STEP * step, PERSIST_MIN * last))
        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            # only the price moves here, and the room is narrow: 0.4 % of C is 8 % of what there is to win on
            # P01 and 19 % on P02 - three such steps met the supplier in round 3 of 10 (P01 0.785, P02 0.421,
            # runs.md P-17). A quarter of the step, at least a twentieth of the room; D01 answered a step of 1 %
            # of the room in crumbs (0.809) and one of 5 % in full (0.957-0.969)
            room = max(0.0, plan.open_c - plan.target_c)
            step = max(RELATIONSHIP_STEP * step, min(min_step, RELATIONSHIP_MIN_STEP * room))
        return min(last + step, their_c, plan.upper_c)  # the upper bound is never asked for beyond

    def _rest_pending(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> bool:
        """It just answered a rival quote we cited with a big step. "I give half the step now and check
        the rest" - "Checked: give the rest of the step" (P05 back office, 47 of 50): the rest comes in its next
        reply whatever we send, so a step of ours now - or a re-anchor's halfway ask - only pays for it (P05: 28.79
        agreed at once; holding gave 0.742 -> 0.824, runs.md P-31). The same back-office rule ran for four
        suppliers in two cases (P05, D02), so it is the arena's, not one supplier's (docs/bot-mechanics.md)."""
        if not plan.our_c:
            return False
        path = self._their_c_path(neg, sid)
        return (
            any(c.kind == "rival_offer" for c in plan.last_claims)
            and len(path) >= 2
            and path[-2] - path[-1] >= BIG_STEP * path[-2]
        )

    def _supplier_done(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> bool:
        """The supplier itself says it is at its end: a final offer, firm words, a stall - or the rounds run out."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        return (
            t.status == "final_offer"
            or reply_signals(t.latest.get("body", ""))["firm"]
            or plan.stalls >= 1
            or self._round_budget(neg, sid) - t.rounds_used <= (2 if self.flags["persistent"] else 3)
        )

    def _round_budget(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> int:
        """Messages we can still expect to play in this thread: the round limit, or the clock."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        limit = neg.case.get("round_limit") or 10
        left = neg.seconds_to_deadline() - 120  # the runner closes before the cap
        if math.isfinite(left):
            per_round = max(15.0, neg.recorder.metrics.mean("supplier.reply_seconds") or 30.0) + 3.0
            limit = min(limit, t.rounds_used + max(1, int(left / per_round)))
        return limit

    def _their_c_path(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> list[float]:
        out = []
        for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages:
            sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
            if sheets:
                c = neg.cost(sid, sheets[0]["terms"])
                if math.isfinite(c):
                    out.append(c)
        return out

    def _may_probe(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, their_c: float) -> bool:
        """Push a final offer once - only when its walking away would cost us little."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        if (neg.case.get("round_limit") or 10) - t.rounds_used < 2 or neg.seconds_to_deadline() < 180:
            return False
        for other, ot in neg.threads.items():
            if other != sid and self.tplans[other].probed_final and ot.live:
                return False  # one rival is already being pushed: this one stays our safe fallback
        for other, ot in neg.threads.items():
            if other != sid and ot.live and ot.standing[0] and not accept_problems(neg, other, ot.standing[0]):
                return True  # a rival offer we could take instead
        return False  # room words alone are no reason: "bridge the remaining gap" (P18) ended in a walk-away

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the offer
    def _undercut_after_big_step(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, theirs: dict) -> bool:
        """It came down to (or under) our own ask in one big step: the back office of case:D02 read
        "I give half the step now and check the rest" - there is more to get."""
        prices = neg.threads[sid].price_path()
        ours = neg.threads[sid].our_price_path()
        if len(prices) < 2 or not ours or theirs.get("unit_price") is None:
            return False
        step = (prices[-2] - prices[-1]) / prices[-2]
        return theirs["unit_price"] <= ours[-1] * 1.005 and step >= BIG_STEP

    def _take_alternative(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> Decision | None:
        """Its alternative sheet costs us less than its primary one: say yes to the alternative as our offer.

        The arena closes an accept on the supplier's primary sheet whatever id we send (P10: we accepted the
        EUR 31.90 alternative and were booked at 33.80) - so the alternative has to come back as our term
        sheet; the supplier then agrees and we close on it. 54 % of all alternatives were cheaper for us."""
        t = neg.threads[sid]
        primary_id, primary = t.standing
        best_id, best = neg.best_offer(sid)
        if not best_id or best_id == primary_id or best_id in plan.alternatives_taken or not self._may_push(neg, sid):
            return None
        best_c, primary_c = neg.cost(sid, best), neg.cost(sid, primary)
        # 0.1 % of the room, not 0.2 % of C: P08's 5 % deadband alternative saved 0.16 % of C and was passed over;
        # taken, P08 0.550 -> 0.560 (runs.md P-34 to P-41)
        margin = self._alt_margin(neg, plan, primary_c)
        if best_c >= primary_c - margin:
            return None
        # only when we would close anyway - in round 1 its alternative is an opening, not a deal (P18 dry run)
        closing = (
            t.status == "final_offer"
            or reply_signals(t.latest.get("body", ""))["firm"]
            or plan.stalls >= 1
            or self._round_budget(neg, sid) - t.rounds_used <= 2
        )
        if self.flags["alt_structure"]:
            if len(neg.threads) > 1 and best_c > self._best_rival_c(neg, sid):
                return None  # a bidder behind the leader keeps its alternative: it stays our lever (P05)
            if not self.flags["persistent"]:  # persistent: only the supplier ends it (P18 gained from not taking 5.20)
                closing = closing or best_c <= plan.stop_c * (1 + STOP_MARGIN)  # at our estimate of its stop (P10)
        if not closing:
            return None
        std = t.standard_terms
        sheet = complete_offer(
            neg.case, {**{k: v for k, v in std.items() if k in neg.case["negotiable"]}, **primary, **best}
        )
        if plan.guess:  # never under the guess floor; then only while it still beats its primary sheet
            sheet["unit_price"] = max(sheet["unit_price"], self._guess_floor(neg, sid, plan, sheet))
            if neg.cost(sid, sheet) >= neg.cost(sid, primary) * (1 - 0.002):
                return None
        if not neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, sheet) or neg.cost(sid, sheet) >= neg.c_alt:
            return None
        if neg.cost(sid, sheet) >= primary_c - margin:
            return None  # completed with its standard terms, the sheet no longer beats its primary offer
        plan.alternatives_taken.add(best_id)
        plan.our_c.append(neg.cost(sid, sheet))
        plan.last_keys = self._keys([{"terms": sheet}])
        body = "\n".join(
            [
                f"Dear {plan.name} team,",
                "",
                self._alternative_line(neg, sheet, best),
                "",
                f"Our proposal: {describe(neg.case, sheet)}",
                "",
                SIGNATURE,
            ]
        )
        return Decision(
            "message",
            sid,
            message={"subject": neg.case.get("title", "Your quote"), "body": body, "term_sheets": [{"terms": sheet}]},
            rationale={"move": "take its alternative", "alternative": best_id, "c": neg.cost(sid, sheet)},
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _alt_margin(neg: Negotiation, plan: Plan, primary_c: float) -> float:
        """How much cheaper its alternative must be to be worth a round: 0.1 % of the room between the opening and
        the supplier's estimated floor, i.e. about 0.001 of the score (the score is the saving as a share of a room
        of the same order). P08's 5 % deadband alternative saved 0.16 % of C, 0.0094 of the score, and fell under
        the old bar of 0.2 % of C in 4 of 4 sessions. Without a floor estimate: 0.05 % of C."""
        room = neg.c_open - plan.lower_c
        if math.isfinite(room) and room > 0:
            return max(ALT_MIN_EUR, ALT_ROOM_SHARE * room)
        return max(ALT_MIN_EUR, 0.0005 * primary_c)

    def _alternative_line(self, neg, sheet: dict, best: dict) -> str:
        if not self.flags["answers"]:
            return "thank you. We accept your alternative as stated below and are ready to place the order on it."
        diffs = [
            f"{FIELD_WORDS.get(f, f.replace('_', ' '))} {sheet[f]} instead of {best[f]}"
            for f in neg.case["negotiable"]
            if f != "unit_price" and f in best and sheet.get(f) != best[f]
        ]
        return "thank you. We can accept your alternative on the terms below" + (
            f" ({'; '.join(diffs)}, the nearest option we can sign)." if diffs else "."
        )

    def _best_rival_c(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> float:
        """The cheapest acceptable standing offer of the other live suppliers (inf if none)."""
        best = math.inf
        for other, ot in neg.threads.items():
            if other != sid and ot.live and ot.standing[0] and not accept_problems(neg, other, ot.standing[0]):
                best = min(best, neg.cost(other, ot.standing[1]))

# AGENTS.md

Instructions for coding agents (Claude Code reads this via the `CLAUDE.md` symlink).

## Repository

Our buyer agent for the Tacto Negotiation Arena (EHL Final 2026).

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `agent/` | `negotiator`: arena API client, runner, telemetry, reports, strategies (Python 3.12, uv) |
| `negotiation-arena-kit/` | git submodule: brief, API docs, data package, starter kit (read-only, do not edit) |
| `bmw_data/` | Source data, git-ignored; never commit it or copy values from it into code |

## Commands

```sh
make install                                   # submodule + uv sync
make test && make lint                         # pytest (incl. arena-sim end to end), ruff
cd agent && uv run negotiator --help           # every API call, play/run/final, report, stats
```

Arena: the key is `ARENA_API_KEY` in the root `.env`. Practice is limited to 200 sessions a day - develop on
`--set sandbox` and the local `arena-sim`; never hard-code values from the data package or replays into code.
During the Live Final the agent must not read the live feed, leaderboard or results (`NEGOTIATOR_FINAL=1`
blocks them in the client).

Before a practice run, try a change to the numbers on `negotiator sim bench` (suppliers fitted from our replays,
no quota); it cannot judge wording, and a difference under 0.08 is noise - see `agent/docs/simulator.md`.

## Benchmarks

Every benchmark run (any `negotiator run` / `play` on sandbox or practice that is used to judge a strategy) gets a
record in `agent/docs/benchmarks/<date>-<strategy>-<model>.md` (e.g. `2026-10-10-lowball-none.md`; `none` when the
strategy uses no LLM), in the same change as the code it measures. Copy the layout of an existing record:

- **Result and cost first:** score per case and mean; the deal's cost `C_deal` in EUR; what the run cost us (practice
  sessions spent, LLM tokens, wall time).
- **Strategy:** its file, a one-line description, the parameters it ran with and the commit - so a later change to
  the strategy can be told apart from the old numbers.
- **Runs:** set and cases, run ID(s) under `agent/runs/`.

A repeat on the same day with the same parameters adds a row to that record; changed parameters or a new day get a
new file. Never rewrite old numbers. Add a line for the run to the overview in `agent/docs/benchmarks/README.md`.
A strategy without an LLM gets the same replies for the same e-mails, so one run is enough; with an LLM the text
varies - compare means over at least three repetitions. Start runs one at a time: the key allows 10 open sessions.

## HARD RULE: confirm before spending practice quota

Practice sessions are a scarce team budget: 200 per team per rolling 24 hours, shared by everyone on the team. A
coding agent must **never** start anything that spends quota without an explicit "yes" from a human in the
conversation, for that specific run. No exceptions, no assumed consent, no carrying a previous "yes" over to a new run.

**What spends quota:** every new practice session, which means:
- `negotiator play <case>` on a practice case (`case:P…`);
- `negotiator run --set practice`;
- `make` targets or scripts that call either of these;
- `POST /v1/sessions` for a practice case.

**What does not spend quota:** `--set sandbox` (cases `case:D…`), the local `arena-sim`, read-only calls
(`me`, `cases`, `sessions`, `session`, `thread`), and the final.

**Before asking, the agent must:**

1. Run `negotiator me` and read the current balance (`used`, `left`, `resets_at`).
2. Ask for confirmation, stating:
   - the exact command;
   - which cases it plays and how many sessions it will spend;
   - the balance before and after the run;
   - when the quota resets.
3. Wait for an explicit yes. Silence, "ok, continue with the task" or approval of an earlier run do not count. If
   the answer is anything but a clear yes, do not run it.

Example of the required question:

> This spends practice quota: `uv run negotiator run --set practice --cases case:P01 case:P05 --strategy tactical`
> → 2 sessions. Balance now 197 / 200 left, after the run 195. Quota resets at 2026-10-11 12:47 UTC. Run it?

## Run registry and pushed code only

**Never run unpushed code on a limited run.** A practice run, or any run that spends quota, must use code that is
committed **and pushed**. Before starting it:
- `git status` is clean;
- `git log origin/main..HEAD` is empty, or the branch is pushed;
- note the hash from `git rev-parse --short HEAD`.

Without this nobody can reproduce or compare the result, and the quota spent on it is wasted. Free runs (sandbox,
local `arena-sim`) may use uncommitted code.

**Every run goes into the registry** [`agent/docs/runs.md`](agent/docs/runs.md): practice runs always, sandbox runs
when they inform a decision. One row per run, with these columns:
- commit;
- strategy;
- parameters (cases, `--llm`, flags);
- author;
- description;
- results (per-case scores and the mean);
- conclusions.

Add the row in the same change that discusses the result.

## Ideas tried

[`agent/docs/TRYED.md`](agent/docs/TRYED.md) lists every idea we have tried: what it was, where it was measured, and
the result - worked (and why), failed (and why), or unknown. Read it before proposing a change, so nobody tests the
same idea twice. Add or update a row in the same change that tries an idea: when the code for it lands (result
"unknown") and again when a run has settled it. Ideas that came from reading replays and were never played go in as
"unknown" too.

## Case triage: where to spend work and attempts

Before working on a strategy or asking for practice sessions, fill this table from the arena's live page
(`https://arena.tacto.ai/live`) and `negotiator me`. Five numbers per case: **ours** (our best score), **house**
(Tacto's house agent), **best** (the best team), **tried** (teams that played it), **beaten** (teams above the house).

Put each case in the first category that fits, and sort inside a category by the gap `best − ours`:

1. **Below the house.** A fault in our agent. First priority.
2. **Above the house, far from the best, and many of the teams that tried beat the house.** There is a known lever
   we do not use. Second priority.
3. **Close to the best, or a high house score that few teams beat.** A ceiling. Spend no attempts.

As of 11 October 2026: house, best, tried and beaten from the live page of 10 October at about 21:05; ours from
`negotiator me` on 11 October at 01:05. Rows keep the order of 10 October (P03 is above the house now). Refresh both before using it.

| Category | Case | Lever, goal | Ours | House | Best | Tried | Beaten | Gap to best |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P08 | raw material, leverage | 0.626 | 0.75 | 0.91 | 22 | 1 | 0.284 |
| 1 | P02 | price increase, stabilise | 0.733 | 0.74 | 0.85 | 21 | 1 | 0.117 |
| 1 | P07 | bundling, routine | 0.740 | 0.78 | 0.81 | 21 | 1 | 0.070 |
| 1 | P01 | price increase, stabilise | 0.969 | 0.97 | 0.99 | 22 | 2 | 0.021 |
| 1 | P10 | capacity, secure_supply | 0.663 | 0.69 | 0.70 | 22 | 3 | 0.037 |
| 1 | P03 | renewal, stabilise | 0.923 | 0.92 | 0.94 | 21 | 1 | 0.017 |
| 2 | P11 | quality, quality_first | 0.692 | 0.31 | 0.81 | 20 | 17 | 0.118 |
| 2 | P05 | RFQ, leverage | 0.839 | 0.56 | 0.92 | 21 | 12 | 0.081 |
| 2 | P18 | raw material, leverage | 0.618 | 0.39 | 0.68 | 20 | 17 | 0.062 |
| 3 | P04 | renewal, routine | 0.860 | 0.86 | 0.87 | 21 | 14 | 0.010 |

We are below the house on six cases. Four of them are `stabilise` or `secure_supply` cases (see the next section).
P01, P02, P10 and P03 are in category 1 by the rule and within 0.12 of the best team.

## Firmness follows the case goal

How hard the agent pushes on price depends on the case's `category_goal`, not on the supplier's opening:

- **`leverage`** (raw material, RFQ): push. Only price and terms count in C.
- **`stabilise` and `secure_supply`:** do not push the price below what the supplier can live on. C carries a
  relationship charge for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier below its sustainable margin
  (`RELATIONSHIP_GOALS` in `arena_kit/cost.py`), so a lower price can cost more than it saves.

Measured on P02 (`stabilise`), [`agent/docs/runs.md`](agent/docs/runs.md) P-13 and P-15:

| Deal price | Relationship charge | Score |
|---|---|---|
| EUR 358.45 | 56,127 | 0.686 |
| EUR 345.39 | 179,204 | 0.000 (C above C_open) |

Our cost estimate had the charge at 0 in both deals. Since `7143676` it is in our C (the supplier's standard terms
from its master data, its full cost at 0.98 of the own-plant should-cost), and the recorded charges are reproduced
to within EUR 56.

**The target is the price that minimises C with the charge, not the price where the charge starts.** Measured
([`agent/docs/investigation-2026-10-10.md`](agent/docs/investigation-2026-10-10.md), `runs.md` P-16 to P-22):

| Case | Price where the charge starts → score | Deal near the minimum of C → score |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | 138.41 at 14 days from April → 0.660 | 131.30 at 30 days from January → 0.969 |
| P02 | 373.56 at 90 days → 0.305 | 362.02 at 90 days with a 5 % deadband clause → 0.733 |

A strategy change that lowers prices must still be checked on the `stabilise` and `secure_supply` cases, and on a
case without a should-cost of the supplier's own plant the charge stays out of our C (sandbox D01).

## Rules

Read the file for the area you touch before changing it:

- [`.agents/git.md`](.agents/git.md) — commit messages (Conventional Commits), branches, pre-commit checks
- [`agent/README.md`](agent/README.md) — package architecture, telemetry layout, how to add a strategy
- [`agent/docs/benchmarks/`](agent/docs/benchmarks/) — one record per benchmark run (see Benchmarks above)
- [`agent/docs/knowledge/competitions-info.md`](agent/docs/knowledge/competitions-info.md) — scoring, practice and
  final rules from the arena's FAQ that the brief does not state; read it before changing how we score, close or run
- [`agent/docs/TRYED.md`](agent/docs/TRYED.md) — every idea tried and what came of it (see Ideas tried above)
- [`agent/docs/backlog.md`](agent/docs/backlog.md) — where the current strategy loses score, and the 7/3 holdout

Files hold measured data only: a number in a doc, a benchmark record or a comment is something a run on the arena
(or a named tool run, e.g. `negotiator sim check`) actually returned, with its source. No predictions, forecasts or
expected scores in files - say them in the conversation, and write the result down once the run has verified it.

General: keep changes scoped to the request, match the surrounding code's style, run the checks above for every
area you changed.

Commit, pull and push regularly, without waiting to be asked - several people and agents work in this repository at
once, and a limited run needs pushed code:
- **pull** before you start and before every push: `git fetch`, then merge `origin/main` into your branch;
- **commit** every finished logical change as soon as `make test && make lint` pass - do not let work pile up;
- **push** your branch after every commit.

Work on a branch, never push to `main` directly and never force-push it (see [`.agents/git.md`](.agents/git.md)).

Costs: report an LLM cost only when the provider measured it (`cost_usd` on the `llm_call` event, e.g.
`claude-code`). When it did not (OpenAI-compatible endpoints return tokens, not money), write
`APPROX-NOT-MEASURED` in place of the amount and give the token counts; never a figure computed from a
remembered price list.

"""A live estimate of the supplier's floor, recomputed after every reply.

The floor is kept as a *value to the supplier* (the arena's `supplier_value`: the price at its own standard
terms that pays it the same - payment timing, freight leg, tooling and chargebacks included), not as a
price, so one number covers every structure. From a floor value V the best package we can reach is exact:
for each structure of the case the lowest price that still gives the supplier V, priced in our C.

Evidence, in the order it arrives:
  prior           the data's estimate before the first move (ground truth: should-cost, case type)
  every offer     its floor is no higher than the value of any sheet it puts on the table
  alternatives    two sheets that differ in payment days only reveal what money is worth to it
  last words      a final offer or "cannot go below EUR X" pins the floor at that value
  its path        bots concede in shrinking steps (half the step, then less): extrapolating the steps
                  gives where it will stop
Recomputing is cheap (a few hundred cost evaluations), so it runs after every reply, well inside 60 s.
"""

import math
import re

from arena_kit.cost import complete_offer, supplier_value

from negotiator.menu import combos

FLOOR_SAID = re.compile(
    r"(?:cannot|can't|unable to) (?:drop|go|reduce|lower)[^.€]{0,40}?(?:below|under|beneath)"
    r"\s*(?:€|EUR)?\s?(\d[\d,]*\.?\d*)"
    r"|(?:stuck|maxed out|limit) at\s*(?:€|EUR)?\s?(\d[\d,]*\.?\d*)",
    re.I,
)
RATE_MIN, RATE_MAX = 0.02, 0.30  # a plausible yearly cost of money for a supplier


class FloorBelief:
    def __init__(self, case: dict, opening: dict, standard: dict, prior_price: float | None, rate: float) -> None:
        b = case["buyer"]
        freight = b.get("freight_eur_per_unit") or {}
        self.case = case
        self.standard = {
            "payment_days": b.get("reference_payment_days", 60),
            "incoterm": case.get("fixed_terms", {}).get("incoterm")
            or (min(freight, key=freight.get) if freight else "FCA"),
            **{k: v for k, v in opening.items() if k != "unit_price"},
            **(standard or {}),
        }
        self.rate = rate
        self.ppm: float | None = None  # its real defect rate (scorecard), when known
        self.structures = [complete_offer(case, {**opening, **c}) for c in combos(case)]
        self.v_open = self.value(opening)
        self.v_hi = self.v_open  # its floor is no higher than any offer it made
        self.v_prior = self.value({**opening, "unit_price": prior_price}) if prior_price else self.v_open * 0.9
        self.v_est = min(self.v_prior, self.v_hi)
        self.path = [self.v_open]
        self.pinned = False
        self.notes: list[str] = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the supplier's view
    def value(self, terms: dict) -> float:
        if terms.get("unit_price") is None:
            return math.inf
        sup = {"standard": self.standard, "interest_rate": self.rate}
        if self.ppm is not None:
            sup["ppm"] = self.ppm  # the defect rate it really has: a chargeback costs it that much per unit
        return supplier_value(self.case, terms, sup)

    def price_for(self, structure: dict, v: float) -> float:
        """The price at which this structure gives the supplier exactly the value v (value is linear in price)."""
        a = self.value({**structure, "unit_price": 1.0})
        b = self.value({**structure, "unit_price": 2.0})
        slope = b - a
        return (v - (a - slope)) / slope if slope > 0 else math.inf

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ evidence
    def observe(self, reply: dict) -> None:
        sheets = [s["terms"] for s in reply.get("term_sheets") or [] if s.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price")]
        self._learn_rate(sheets)
        if sheets:
            v = min(self.value(s) for s in sheets)
            self.path.append(v)
            self.v_hi = min(self.v_hi, v)
        said = self._floor_said(reply.get("body") or "", sheets)
        if said is not None:
            self.v_hi = min(self.v_hi, said)
            self.pinned = True
            self.notes.append(f"floor said: {said:.2f}")
        if reply.get("status") == "final_offer":
            self.pinned = True
        self._update_estimate()

    def _learn_rate(self, sheets: list[dict]) -> None:
        """Two sheets that differ in payment days only: the price gap is what that money is worth to it."""
        for i, s1 in enumerate(sheets):
            for s2 in sheets[i + 1 :]:
                diff = {k for k in set(s1) | set(s2) if k != "unit_price" and s1.get(k) != s2.get(k)}
                if diff != {"payment_days"}:
                    continue
                d1, d2 = s1.get("payment_days"), s2.get("payment_days")
                if not d1 or not d2 or d1 == d2:
                    continue
                long_, short = (s1, s2) if d1 > d2 else (s2, s1)
                gap = long_["unit_price"] - short["unit_price"]
                days = abs(d1 - d2)
                if gap > 0:
                    rate = gap / short["unit_price"] * 360 / days
                    self.rate = min(RATE_MAX, max(RATE_MIN, rate))
                    self.notes.append(f"rate from alternatives: {self.rate:.3f}")

    def _floor_said(self, body: str, sheets: list[dict]) -> float | None:
        if not sheets:
            return None
        for m in FLOOR_SAID.finditer(body):
            raw = m.group(1) or m.group(2)
            try:
                price = float(raw.replace(",", ""))
            except ValueError:
                continue
            ref = min(sheets, key=lambda s: abs(s["unit_price"] - price))
            return self.value({**ref, "unit_price": price})
        return None

    def _update_estimate(self) -> None:
        if self.pinned:  # its last word: the floor is where it stands
            self.v_est = self.v_hi
            return
        p = self.path
        extrap = None
        if len(p) >= 2 and p[-2] - p[-1] <= 0.005 * p[-2]:
            # no move in value - a lower price paid for by our concessions (P18: 6.10 -> 5.60 for 90 days, 24
            # months and a clause was the same value to it): it stands at, or near, its floor
            extrap = p[-1]
        elif len(p) >= 3:
            d1, d2 = p[-3] - p[-2], p[-2] - p[-1]
            if d1 > 0 and 0 < d2 < d1:
                r = d2 / d1
                extrap = p[-1] - d2 * r / (1 - r)  # the steps shrink geometrically: sum what is left
            elif d1 > 0 and d2 <= 0:
                extrap = p[-1]  # it stopped
        elif len(p) == 2 and p[0] > p[1]:
            # bots move most in round 1 (67 % of all their movement), then about 0.4 of that step more
            extrap = p[1] - 0.4 * (p[0] - p[1])
        if extrap is None:
            self.v_est = min(self.v_est, self.v_hi)
            return
        weight = 0.6 if len(p) == 2 else 0.85  # its own moves outweigh our prior quickly (prior: data before round 1)
        self.v_est = min(self.v_hi, weight * extrap + (1 - weight) * self.v_prior)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ what it means for us
    def best_package(self, cost, keeps, v: float | None = None, allow=None) -> tuple[float, dict | None]:
        """The cheapest package (in our C) that gives the supplier at least v (default: our estimate), among the
        structures it would sign (`allow`: e.g. only with the index clause it insists on - a clause is no cash
        to it, so its value does not see it, but its refusals do)."""
        v = self.v_est if v is None else v
        best, best_terms = math.inf, None
        pool = [st for st in self.structures if allow is None or allow(st)] or self.structures
        for st in pool:
            price = self.price_for(st, v)
            if not math.isfinite(price) or price <= 0:
                continue
            terms = complete_offer(self.case, {**st, "unit_price": round(price + 0.005, 2)})
            if not keeps(terms):
                continue
            c = cost(terms)
            if c < best:
                best, best_terms = c, terms
        return best, best_terms

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "v_open": round(self.v_open, 2),
            "v_prior": round(self.v_prior, 2),
            "v_est": round(self.v_est, 2),
            "v_hi": round(self.v_hi, 2),
            "rate": round(self.rate, 3),
            "pinned": self.pinned,
            "notes": self.notes[-3:],
        }

1	"""Tactical buyer: category goal + supplier profile -> tactics; tit-for-tat Boulware concessions in C.
2	
3	Ideas taken from ASTRA (Kwon et al., github.com/DSincerity/ASTRA-NegoAgent) - the tactics, not the
4	code: a model of the opponent, an optimiser over the published cost function, several offers of
5	equal value to us that differ in what they give the supplier, and concessions that answer the
6	supplier's (no move from it, no move from us).
7	
8	Per case (prepare):
9	  - the category goal sets the policy: how deep we anchor, how slowly we concede (Boulware beta),
10	    how much of the supplier's move we answer (reciprocity), whether we protect its margin;
11	  - the supplier's profile (profile.py) adjusts it: idle capacity -> anchor deeper; fully booked or
12	    below cost -> shallower; cash-short -> offer early payment; hedged -> skip index arguments ...;
13	  - target C: the deepest credible price (anchor, should-cost, history, alternative), never below
14	    what the supplier can sell at (its full cost, plus the sustainable margin where squeezing costs C).
15	
16	Per round (decide), all in C (our total cost, the score's currency):
17	  - their concession = drop of C of their standing sheet; ours = drop of the C we ask for;
18	  - next ask: the Boulware curve over the rounds we can still play (round limit and the clock),
19	    capped by reciprocity - if they did not move, we hold (then a half step to break a deadlock;
20	    the third stall settles the thread);
21	  - up to three term sheets at that same C: our C-optimal terms; a trade the supplier values
22	    (early payment for the cash-short, a long commitment for those who want volume or security);
23	    a pure price move on its own terms. Whatever it agrees to costs us the same.
24	  - arguments: checkable evidence picked by the profile; what came back irrelevant or contradicted
25	    is not used again.
26	Closing: the cheapest standing sheet that passes the guards (guards.py), else walk away; a
27	`final_offer` is probed once with a trade when walking would cost us little. Our estimate of its floor
28	never ends an open thread: the supplier does (a final offer, firm words, a stall) or the rounds run out.
29	Conduct (conduct.py): honest, sourced, no empty threats, the supplier's margin respected - code-checked on send.

280	class TacticalStrategy(BaselineStrategy):
281	    name = "tactical"
282	
283	    def __init__(self, data: WorldData | None = None, llm=None, **flags) -> None:
284	        super().__init__(data, llm)
285	        unknown = set(flags) - set(FLAGS)
286	        if unknown:
287	            raise ValueError(f"unknown tactical flags: {sorted(unknown)}")
288	        self.flags = {name: bool(flags.get(name, name in DEFAULT_ON)) for name in FLAGS}
289	        if self.flags["respond_all"] or self.flags["respond_lite"]:
290	            self.flags["answers"] = True  # its plain answers are part of answering everything
291	        if self.flags["guess_anchor"]:
292	            self.flags["guess_slack"] = True  # the deep ask needs the (lowered) guessed floor under it
293	        self.tplans: dict[str, Plan] = {}
294	        self.banned_case_kinds: set[str] = set()  # contradicted: never again in this case
295	
296	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ prepare
297	    def prepare(self, neg: Negotiation) -> None:
298	        if neg.data is not None:
299	            self.data = neg.data  # the session's view for this case: its own facts (WorldData.with_case)
300	        buyer = neg.buyer
301	        goal = buyer.get("category_goal", "routine")
302	        parts = neg.case.get("parts") or []
303	        current = buyer.get("current_unit_price")
304	        for sid, thread in neg.threads.items():
305	            _, terms = thread.standing
306	            profile = build_profile(self.data, sid, neg.case)
307	            policy = self._policy(goal, profile)
308	            full_cost = self._full_cost(parts, sid)
309	            cost_source = "own plant" if full_cost else ""
310	            if full_cost and goal in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
311	                full_cost = round(full_cost * SHOULD_COST_SHARE, 2)  # one cost for the charge and the floor
312	            guess = None
313	            if not full_cost and goal in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
314	                guessed, cost_source = self._fallback_full_cost(neg, sid)
315	                guess = self._supplier_estimate(neg, sid, guessed, profile) if guessed else None
316	            self._estimate_supplier(neg, sid, full_cost, profile)
317	            floor = self._floor(neg, full_cost, policy)
318	            open_c = neg.cost(sid, terms)
319	            gt = estimate(self.data, neg.case, sid, terms.get("unit_price"), tuple(profile.traits))
320	            if gt.lower and goal not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
321	                floor = gt.lower  # one floor: the ground truth's (it knows below-cost sellers and countries)
322	            target_c = self._target_c(neg, sid, terms, policy, profile, floor, current, gt)
323	            plan = Plan(sid, self._name(sid), policy, profile, open_c, target_c, floor, full_cost, gt)
324	            plan.guess = guess
325	            if self.flags["justified_arg"]:
326	                plan.justified_note = self._justified_note(neg, thread, terms)
327	            plan.lower_c, plan.upper_c = self._bounds_c(neg, sid, terms, gt, target_c, open_c)
328	            if terms.get("unit_price") is not None:
329	                rate = buyer.get("interest_rate", 0.08) * (2 if profile.has("cash_short") else 1)

386	    def _policy(self, goal: str, p: SupplierProfile) -> Policy:
387	        base = POLICIES.get(goal, DEFAULT_POLICY)
388	        anchor, beta, recip = base.anchor, base.beta, base.reciprocity
389	        trade = list(base.trade_first)
390	        if p.has("underutilised"):
391	            anchor, beta = anchor + 0.03, beta + 0.5
392	        markup = base.markup
393	        if p.has("full_order_book") or p.has("below_cost"):
394	            anchor = max(0.02, anchor - 0.03)
395	            markup = max(markup, 0.0)  # no room under its cost: it is already there or does not need us
396	        if p.has("price_frozen"):
397	            anchor = max(0.02, anchor - 0.02)
398	        if p.has("approval_ladder"):
399	            beta += 0.5  # it moves in small approved steps: no reason for us to move fast
400	        if p.has("cash_short"):
401	            trade.insert(0, "payment_days")
402	        if p.has("wants_volume") or p.has("full_order_book") or p.has("price_frozen"):
403	            trade += ["contract_months", "volume_per_year"]
404	        if p.has("we_pay_late") or p.has("relationship"):
405	            recip = min(1.0, recip + 0.1)
406	        return Policy(anchor, beta, recip, markup, base.claims_first, tuple(dict.fromkeys(trade)))

408	    def _evidence(self, neg, sid, open_price, current):
409	        out = super()._evidence(neg, sid, open_price, current)
410	        if self.data:
411	            parts = neg.case.get("parts") or []
412	            out += self.data.evidence_orders(parts, sid, open_price)
413	            if self.flags["fresh_args"]:
414	                out += self.data.evidence_orders_per_part(parts, sid)
415	            out += data_facts(self.data, parts, all_windows=self.flags["all_windows"])
416	            if self.flags["fresh_claims"]:
417	                later = self.data.evidence_complaints(parts, sid, since="2025-10-01")
418	                if open_price and not any(e.kind == "should_cost" for e in out):
419	                    later += self.data.evidence_should_cost(parts, open_price, margin=1.0)
420	                for e in later:  # material for rounds 2+: round 1 already carries our best three
421	                    e.meta = {**(e.meta or {}), "later": True}
422	                out += later
423	        return sorted(out, key=lambda e: -e.strength)

425	    def _full_cost(self, parts: list[str], supplier_id: str) -> float | None:
426	        """The should-cost of THIS supplier's plant for a single-part case; None otherwise.
427	
428	        Another supplier's estimate is a different plant (cost base, process) and a bundle's price is
429	        not one part's cost: guessing would push the floor and the margin charge the wrong way."""
430	        if not self.data or len(parts) != 1:
431	            return None
432	        rows = self.data.query(
433	            "SELECT unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ? AND supplier_id = ? ORDER BY estimate_date DESC",
434	            (parts[0], supplier_id),
435	        )
436	        return rows[0]["unit_cost"] if rows and rows[0]["unit_cost"] else None

438	    def _fallback_full_cost(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> tuple[float | None, str]:
439	        """A strategic supplier's full cost where its own plant has no should-cost: the price of the main sheet of
440	        its first message less the sustainable margin, x SHOULD_COST_SHARE (its alternatives are other structures,
441	        and a cheaper one would set the guess too low). None where the case puts no price on the supplier's margin
442	        (no charge to protect) or nothing is quoted."""
443	        buyer = neg.buyer
444	        margin = buyer.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
445	        if not margin or not buyer.get("relationship_eur_per_point"):
446	            return None, ""
447	        first = next((m for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages if m.get("term_sheets")), None)
448	        opening = ((first or {}).get("term_sheets") or [{}])[0].get("terms", {}).get("unit_price")
449	        if not isinstance(opening, int | float) or opening <= 0:
450	            return None, ""
451	        return round(opening * (1 - margin / 100) * SHOULD_COST_SHARE, 2), "opening less the sustainable margin"
452	
453	    def _guess_floor(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan, terms: dict) -> float:
454	        """Under a guessed cost, the price that minimises C on these terms with the guessed charge (0 without a
455	        guess): no ask and no accept goes under it."""
456	        if not plan.guess or terms.get("unit_price") is None or self.flags["no_guess_floor"]:
457	            return 0.0
458	        std = neg.threads[sid].standard_terms
459	
460	        def c(price: float) -> float:
461	            return total_cost(neg.case, {**terms, "unit_price": price}, std, plan.guess)
462	
463	        lo, hi = 0.0, terms["unit_price"] * 1.5
464	        for _ in range(60):
465	            a, b = lo + (hi - lo) / 3, hi - (hi - lo) / 3
466	            if c(a) < c(b):
467	                hi = b
468	            else:
469	                lo = a
470	        floor = math.ceil((lo + hi) / 2 * 100 - 1e-6) / 100
471	        if self.flags["guess_slack"]:
472	            # the guess sat up to 3.5 % above the arena's cost (D01): a floor that high left 2.5 % of room and D01
473	            # fell 0.969 -> 0.669; under it by its own error the floor still stops a P02-like squeeze
474	            floor = round(floor * (1 - GUESS_SLACK), 2)
475	        return floor

477	    def _standard_terms(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str) -> dict:
478	        """The supplier's standard terms for the relationship term: its quote PDF, then its master data, then its
479	        opening sheet. The PDFs of P01, P02, P03 and P10 name neither payment nor Incoterm, which left the charge
480	        out of C altogether (P02 closed at 345.39 with EUR 179k of it, score 0). What stays unknown is taken as
481	        the value that charges most - too high a charge costs a little price, too low a charge scores 0."""
482	        std = dict(neg.threads[sid].standard_terms)
483	        master = (self.data.supplier(sid) if self.data else None) or {}
484	        first = next((m for m in neg.threads[sid].supplier_messages if m.get("term_sheets")), None)
485	        opening = first["term_sheets"][0]["terms"] if first else {}
486	        fixed = neg.case.get("fixed_terms", {})
487	        for name in ("payment_days", "incoterm"):
488	            for source in (master, opening):
489	                if std.get(name) is None and fixed.get(name) is None and source.get(name) is not None:
490	                    std[name] = source[name]
491	        freight = neg.buyer["freight_eur_per_unit"]
492	        if std.get("incoterm") not in freight and fixed.get("incoterm") is None:
493	            std["incoterm"] = max(freight, key=freight.get)
494	        if std.get("payment_days") is None and fixed.get("payment_days") is None:
495	            options = neg.case.get("term_options", {}).get("payment_days") or []
496	            std["payment_days"] = min(options, default=neg.buyer["reference_payment_days"])
497	        return std

515	    def _update_upper(self, neg: Negotiation, sid: str, plan: Plan) -> None:
516	        """The upper bound follows the evidence: where this supplier will stop with us (its offers, last words,
517	        the shrinking path of its steps), priced on the best structure. Offline on 28 practice sessions this
518	        estimate met the real stopping point within 8 % before the first reply and 1-3 % by round 3-4.
519	        The anchor stays where the data put it; only how far we go and when we take it follow the supplier."""
520	        _, theirs = neg.threads[sid].standing
521	        insisted = {r for r, n in plan.request_counts.items() if n >= 2}
522	        stop_c, stop_terms = plan.belief.best_package(
523	            lambda t: neg.cost(sid, t),
524	            lambda t: neg.keeps_must_haves(sid, t),
525	            allow=lambda t: all(satisfies(neg.case, t, theirs or {}, r, plan.proposed) for r in insisted),
526	        )
527	        if not math.isfinite(stop_c):
528	            return
529	        _, terms = neg.threads[sid].standing
530	        cap = min(neg.c_alt, neg.cost(sid, terms) if terms else math.inf, plan.open_c)
531	        before = plan.upper_c
532	        plan.stop_c = stop_c
533	        plan.upper_c = min(max(stop_c * (1 + STOP_MARGIN), plan.target_c * (1 + UPPER_ROOM)), cap)
534	        if neg.supplier_estimates.get(sid):
535	            # where only the price moves, 1 % and 6 % of C are more than the whole room (P01: 5 %, P02: 2 %):
536	            # the bound became the supplier's current offer and every offer counted as good enough - P01 took an
537	            # alternative in round 3 at 134.80 while the supplier was still coming down (0.733, P-20)
538	            room = max(0.0, plan.open_c - plan.target_c)
539	            plan.upper_c = min(max(stop_c + STOP_ROOM * room, plan.target_c + UPPER_ROOM_SHARE * room), cap)
540	        neg.recorder.event(
541	            "belief",
542	            session_id=neg.session_id,
543	            supplier_id=sid,
544	            belief=plan.belief.summary(),
545	            stop_c=round(stop_c, 2),
546	            stop_price=(stop_terms or {}).get("unit_price"),
547	            upper_before=round(before, 2) if math.isfinite(before) else None,
548	            upper_after=round(plan.upper_c, 2) if math.isfinite(plan.upper_c) else None,
549	        )
550	        log.info(
551	            "%s belief: stop ~%s (price %s), upper %s -> %s",
552	            sid,
553	            _k(stop_c),
554	            (stop_terms or {}).get("unit_price"),
555	            _k(before),
556	            _k(plan.upper_c),
557	        )

559	    def _floor(self, neg: Negotiation, full_cost: float | None, policy: Policy) -> float | None:
560	        if not full_cost:
561	            return None
562	        if neg.buyer.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
563	            margin = neg.buyer.get("sustainable_margin_pct") or 0
564	            return round(full_cost / (1 - margin / 100), 2)
565	        return round(full_cost * (1 + policy.markup), 2)
